method: Association-aware country/territory histories combining official OFC/FIFA structural evidence with Big Count 2006 and modern FIFA development support.
evidence_rules: Tahiti football observations map to Earth code PYF and never inherit metropolitan France evidence.
New Caledonia football observations map to NCL and never inherit metropolitan France evidence.
American Samoa football governance is independent of United States political sovereignty in the sporting evidence layer.
American Samoa's 2005–07 normalisation is a real governance discontinuity, not smooth interpolation.
Big Count 2006 primarily anchors popularity/access; no Professional 2023 rows means modern competition/support remain conservative rather than zero.
Tahiti's 2023 pitch and 2025 Talent Academy, and New Caledonia's current Forward support, are modern anchors only and are never backcast.

country_notes.ASM: Youth-focused football with meaningful participation access, but limited elite/competition depth and an explicit 2005–07 governance break.
country_notes.PYF: Tahiti/French Polynesia has high participation and cultural popularity with strong recent development investment; all football evidence remains association-specific to PYF.
country_notes.NCL: New Caledonia has federation and league history from 1928, later FIFA/OFC membership in 2004, and strong modern support investment without importing France-level evidence.
